# Known-indexed capture geometry (CCP4 example data: insulin_1_001.img)
#
# This is a REAL ipmosflm capture target, not a synthetic fixture.
#
# Detector (from the SMV header):
#   type:       ADSC Quantum (SMV), 2-byte unsigned short, little endian
#   size:       2304 x 2304, pixel 0.0816 mm (square)
#   distance:   160.0 mm
#   beam:       (94.0, 94.7) mm
#   wavelength: 0.9790 A
#   scan:       phi 0.0 -> 1.0 deg (OSC_RANGE 1.0, PHI 0.0)
#
# Indexing (ipmosflm DPS autoindex, solution 12):
#   space group: I23 (number 197, cI)
#   regularized cell: 78.190 78.190 78.190 90.0 90.0 90.0
#
# Orientation (as printed by ipmosflm "Crystal Parameters"; see ipmosflm.log):
#   Rotation matrix U defining standard setting:
#       -0.97734 -0.02860 -0.20972
#        0.17495  0.44851 -0.87649
#        0.11912 -0.89332 -0.43335
#   Orientation Matrix [A] (components of A*,B*,C* along X,Y,Z):
#       -0.012237 -0.000358 -0.002626
#        0.002191  0.005616 -0.010974
#        0.001492 -0.011185 -0.005426
#
# Oracle outputs (testdata/oracle/known_indexed/):
#   insulin_1.spt          spot list (612 spots) from phase-1 spot search
#   insulin_1_001.mtz      integrated frame; columns include H K L
#                          M/ISYM BATCH I SIGI IPR SIGIPR FRACTIONCALC
#                          XDET YDET ROT WIDTH LP MPART FLAG BGPKRATIOS
#                          (XDET/YDET are the predicted detector pixel
#                          coordinates ipmosflm used for each reflection)
#   ipmosflm.log           full ipmosflm run log
#
# Lab frame (mosflm::mosflm_lab_to_cpp): MOSFLM photons travel +X (S0=(-1,0,0)
# is antiparallel), spindle +Z; C++ photons +Z, spindle +X. Map
# R=[[0,0,1],[0,-1,0],[1,0,0]] so UB_cpp = R * A. CTest insulin_hkl_overlap:
# ASU-aware recall 100% vs insulin_1_001.mtz (exact HKL may differ by SG/Friedel).
# Next: XDET/YDET positional differential (GENDATA XG∥lab Y, YG∥lab Z).
# Experimental Autotools splice: make -C mosflm MOSFLM_CPP_PREDICT=1 ipmosflm
